about: The Moon's planned ground round the base of the game 2099 (its game/world/ground/moon_plan.json, #130 there): the heights picture (sixteen bits in red and green: height = code / 65535 * span - low, metres), its skin (the same square), the square's side in metres, the ball's radius, the base seat's way out the square is laid on (ModuleFloors.STANDS), and each place's seat: its way out and its heading (radians about out), as the game's Seat has them. The wreck's is the base seat walked 55 m on the bearing (-30, 100) and turned so its along runs home (Wreck.seat); the old station's is the base seat itself, its layout offset by the kit's on_seat.

detail.about: The ground shader's detail (2099's ink_ground.gdshader, its regolith_ground.tres material), baked into each place's near ground by tools/usd/ground_detail.py: the moon rock and ink colours (sRGB, as the material's source colours), the two scans of real ground it lays and the plan's relief picture (in the world's folder), and how many of its drawn pits and inked pebbles the Moon keeps (all).
detail.from: game/art/materials/regolith_ground.tres (flat_color, ink_color, the scans, plan_relief); ink_ground.gdshader:52-58 (pits_share and pebbles_share default to 1 on the Moon)
